item.description:
Changes since v0.2.50:
- A new Light mode switch in Settings, General (off by default) lets pinch-and-drag scroll the window of another app that you look at, with a short note on the island; dictation, send and every other gesture still work only on Claude. - The home page no longer downloads the demo's 12 MB of hand and face tracking files when it opens; they download only when you start the demo. - Release notes are now built from one small note file per pull request, so open pull requests no longer conflict over the changelog. - The usage monitor runs as a launchd job on the owner's Mac with no Claude app (#259) - The website's browser test matches the current page and lists what it skips and why (#257) - The website test server finds the app's 3D and tracker files again (ENS-162) (#256)

sparkles | The update button spins while an | The update button spins while an update checks, downloads or installs, and shows the stage and download percentage wand.and.stars | The usage triage tests run in | The usage triage tests run in the checks, and the gate requires them (ENS-178) hand.raised | Releases carry a small delta and | Releases carry a small delta and roll out to installed copies over about a week gearshape | The website stops carrying its own | The website stops carrying its own copies of the 3D and face tracker files bolt | The social preview card is re-rendered | The social preview card is re-rendered from the README hero with the deeper skin (ENS-117)

sparkles | Updates open a What's new window | Updates open a What's new window with three to five items, and a release without a summary is refused wand.and.stars | Shipping a release refuses a skipped | Shipping a release refuses a skipped version or a build number that does not rise hand.raised | Comment and guide stop naming the | Comment and guide stop naming the deleted release scripts (ENS-171) gearshape | The release docs name only the | The release docs name only the auto-release workflow and the two launchd release scripts are deleted bolt | Tests pin the switch-off wait at | Tests pin the switch-off wait at 8 seconds and the send wait cap at 1.2 seconds
